newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Tajo to make announcement.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Tajo to make announcement.

text.p: Malaysian building materials manufacturer Tajo Bhd said on Thursday that it would be making an announcement following speculative buying of its stock.
An official at the company said that she could not confirm the nature of the announcement nor its date.
Tajo stock closed up 1.05 ringgit at 6.90 ringgit at the midday close on Thursday. It was the most actively-traded stock, with 11.4 million shares traded as at midday.
Dealers speculated that Tajo may be about to win contracts connected to the building of Putrajaya, the new administrative capital just outside Kuala Lumpur.
